import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    g=np.exp(-p[5]*T)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2+p[3]*np.log(T)+p[4]*g+p[6]*eps**p[9]
            +p[7]*eps**2+p[8]*eps**2*g)
